tomeofblood.glyph_desc.glyph_sentient_ha: Consumes Spiritus to attack your target. Damage scales with the Spiritus you carry, and the target drops Spiritus when killed. With Extend Time, it applies an effect based on your Spiritus type instead: Raw causes Poison, Ruina causes Wither, Vindicta causes Weakness, Invictus causes Slowness and Nihilum causes Vulnerable.
tomeofblood.glyph_desc.glyph_sentient_wr: Marks a target on the first hit. Attacking a marked target does a heavy attack that scales with your Spiritus, hits everything in a radius and marks them all. Consumes Spiritus. Killing a target grants a bonus unless you are using Raw Spiritus: Ruina grants Resistance, Vindicta grants Speed, Invictus grants Absorption and Nihilum grants Spell Damage.
tomeofblood.page1.heretics_armor: Heretic's Armor is an upgrade of Neo Vitae's Sentient Armor. It combines Sentient Armor with Ars Nouveau's magical armor and has access to both perk threads and sentient upgrades.
tomeofblood.page1.mana_attunement: Mana Attunement is a sentient upgrade that lowers the mana cost of your spells by 5% per level, up to 20%. It is trained by casting spells while wearing a full Sentient set. Max level: 4.
tomeofblood.page1.mint_tea: Slightly toxic... Drinking it grants Serene, which gives you 10% more EV when you sacrifice your own health. It has a 5% chance to turn toxic.
tomeofblood.page1.tome_of_blood: A Tome of Blood is a spell book with a connection to its owner's Anima network. It lets you break through the mana cost limits of your spells.
tomeofblood.page2.heretics_armor: The Robes hold sentient upgrade points like a Sentient Plate, and every piece counts toward a full Sentient set. Each piece is made in the Enchanting Apparatus from the matching Sentient piece and keeps its upgrades.
tomeofblood.page2.mana_attunement:
Level 1: 4 upgrade points
Level 2: 10 upgrade points
Level 3: 22 upgrade points
Level 4: 40 upgrade points
tomeofblood.page2.mint_tea: Mint Tea is brewed in the Tabula Vitae from Sugar, two Seagrass and a Water Bottle.
tomeofblood.page2.tome_of_blood: The tome casts spells with your mana first. If you do not have enough mana, it takes the rest of the cost from your Anima network, at 10 EV per point of mana by default.
tomeofblood.page3.tome_of_blood: A Tome of Blood is made by placing a spell book in the Ara Vitae. Each tier of spell book becomes the matching tier of tome and keeps its spells. Tomes can be upgraded to the next tier in the Tabula Vitae. Check JEI for the recipes.
